text:
sara: FYI customer (Fortify Analytics) wants an air-gapped POC next month. Requirements: signed offline bundles, SBOM, ability to apply security patches on a monthly or ad-hoc cadence, and no external egress from the cluster.

tom: Got it. Do they require HSM/KMS integration for keys or will key injection during install be enough?

sara: Security team flagged HSM for production but POC can use ephemeral keys if we document rotation. They asked about delta updates (not full images) to reduce bandwidth.

elaine: We have a delta-bundle prototype but it relies on our chunked-bundle format. Ops note: delta patches require matching base SHA256. We can provide a small tool to apply patches offline.

mike: From security: need signed artifacts (detached signature + cert chain), SBOM, and reproducible build hashes. Also request a short runbook: how to revoke an image and roll back if a patch breaks things.

sara: Customer Qs on upgrade cadence: they asked if we can support weekly security patches for the POC vs our typical monthly windows. Pricing impact?

tom: Weekly -> extra engineering ops support. For POC we can offer a zero-cost exception for first 8 weeks if they commit to production. If they want ensured rapid patching beyond that, we'd propose a support add-on.

elaine: Implementation details: offline bundle layout we provide: 
```
/bundle/
  metadata.json   # includes version, dependencies, SBOM reference
  artifacts/      # model weights, runtime binaries (quantized bundles)
  deltas/         # delta patches named by from->to hashes
  signatures/     # .sig for each artifact
```

Example signature check: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature artifacts/model.bin.sig artifacts/model.bin`

mike: Also note certificate rotation in sealed environments: customers often expect we support cert renewal without internet. We can provide an offline cert-rotation helper and a documented sequence (generate CSR locally -> sign offline -> import). Need to include that in Q&A.

sara: Security questionnaire item: "Can Redwood attest that <runtime> does not phone home?" Answer: runtime has optional telemetry; for Private/air-gapped we ship a runtime build with telemetry disabled and the console communicates only if customer enables a proxy. Include exact config flags.

tom: Can we offer signed SBOM + binary signing as part of POC delivery? I can prepare a checklist.

elaine: Yes. But note: quantized model bundles produce deterministic outputs only if build env matches. We'll add build env metadata to metadata.json so customers can reproduce if needed.

mike: Enterprise blocker: legal wants indemnity language tied to offline patches. Sales should loop legal early.

sara: @tom can you draft a minimal deliverable list for the customer: offline bundle, delta tool, signature verification steps, cert rotation guide, and an operations runbook? I'll attach to the next SOW.

tom: On it. Timeline: draft by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: build-ops: offline-bundle-tool v0.9.1 uploaded to internal artifacts (sha256: 3f7a1b2c...).

elaine: I'll attach a short sample snippet for the SOW showing patch flow and a sample curl command for offline ingestion (they'll run this behind a bastion):
```
# import signed bundle
cat bundle.tar.gz | ./offline-apply --verify --pubkey /root/pubkey.pem
```

sara: Great. Also need pricing note: propose free POC packaging + a one-time packaging fee of $X for production bundles + a monthly support line item for accelerated patch cadence. Sales to confirm numbers.

mike: I'll prepare the security answers for the customer questionnaire and flag anything that needs legal.

sara: Thanks all — will update Fortify and book follow-up call. :thumbsup:
